communityTips.title: Faucet Aerator Installation & Flow Restriction
communityTips.tip: Installing a 2.5 liter-per-minute aerator on your kitchen and bathroom sink faucets reduces flow rates by up to 50% compared to standard 6–9 liter taps without compromising rinse pressure.
communityTips.sourceAuthority: DENR-EMB Guidelines on Domestic Water Efficiency

communityTips.title: Two-Step Toilet Tank Dye Test
communityTips.tip: Place 4–5 drops of food coloring into your toilet tank and wait 15 minutes without flushing. If color seeps into the bowl, the rubber flapper valve is worn and leaking up to 200 liters of water daily.
communityTips.practicalImpact: Eliminates silent leaks of 100–200 Liters daily

communityTips.title: Graywater Reuse for Non-Edible Irrigation
communityTips.tip: Water used for washing uncooked vegetables and rice rinsing (hugas-bigas) contains trace minerals and can be safely applied directly to ornamental shrubs and tree beds, eliminating potable tap usage for gardening.
communityTips.sourceAuthority: UN-Water Guidelines on Safe Graywater Utilization

communityTips.title: Alternate Wetting and Drying (AWD) Principle
communityTips.tip: Applying the AWD method to home gardens and urban plots—allowing the topsoil to dry slightly before re-saturating—develops deeper root systems and cuts irrigation demand by 25% to 30%.
communityTips.sourceAuthority: International Rice Research Institute (IRRI) AWD Guidelines
